verdict.rationale: Manufact has a public MCP catalog where you can browse checklist scores and run a readiness scan against any MCP URL without signing in [manufact-docs-33]. That gives some pre-connection insight into listed servers, but nothing shows the catalog exposing a server's tool list, input schemas, transport type, or hosting attributes. The local inspector [manufact-docs-15] applies only to servers you run yourself. Missing for 10: per-server tool listings, input schema display, transport details, hosting attributes in catalog entries, and any hands-on corroboration.
